name: aicte-fdr-vault
description: AICTE FDR Vault - Transparent. Tracked. Timely.

scripts.setup: npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend
scripts.setup:backend: cd backend && pnpm install && npx prisma generate && npx prisma db push && npx tsx prisma/seed.ts
scripts.dev: npx concurrently --names "API,WEB" --prefix-colors "blue,green" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: cd backend && pnpm run build && cd ../frontend && pnpm run build
